newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end little changed, give up earlier gains.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end little changed, give up earlier gains.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures gave up most of their earlier gains by late afternoon and ended Thursday's Tokyo session just slightly higher.

The June contract closed up 0.03 at 123.75. Turnover was 65,155 lots. Traders said the benchmark was boosted in the morning by a fall in Tokyo stocks, but gave up gains in the afternoon as the Nikkei went back up above 20,000.
"People continued to watch the Nikkei for clues. The activity was led by dealers. Most investors stayed away," said a brokerage house trader.
